info.headline: Flood Warning issued September 25 at 3:12AM CDT until September 25 at 8:00AM CDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
info.description:
...The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Texas...
Rio Grande at Rio Grande near Castolon, Texas affecting Brewster County.
For the Rio Grande...including Rio Grande near Castolon, Texas... Minor flooding is forecast.
* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.
* WHERE...Rio Grande at Rio Grande near Castolon, Texas.
* WHEN...From early this morning to this morning.
* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, the river reaches bankfull, and no significant damage is expected. At 15.0 feet, the river reaches minor flood stage, and lowland flooding begins. The river begins to flood the road between Santa Elena Canyon and Cottonwood Campground in Big Bend National Park. The river begins to flood the parking lot at Santa Elena Canyon, and cut off the nature trail into the canyon. Campers in Cottonwood Campground need to prepare for possible evacuations.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 2:15 AM CDT Friday the stage was 16.6 feet (5.1 meters). - Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet (4.0 meters). - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 2:15 AM CDT Friday was 16.6 feet (5.1 meters). - Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 16.8 feet (5.1 meters) early this morning. It will then fall below flood stage later this morning. - Flood stage is 15.0 feet (4.6 meters). - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the dangers of flooding.
Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.
The next statement will be issued this morning at 800 AM CDT.
